raw_segments.text: When I refuse to obey an unjust law, I do not contest the right which the majority has
of commanding, but I simply appeal from the sovereignty of the people to the sovereignty
It has been asserted that a people can never entirely outstep the boundaries of justice
and of reason in those affairs which are more peculiarly its own, and that consequently,
full power may fearlessly be given to the majority by which it is represented.
But this language is that of a slave.
